This is kidnapping/abduction of a child. Not covered by the three listed charges. The instruction says: "If no listed name fits, use the correct statutory name anyway." So we need to provide the appropriate charge for kidnapping/abduction. In Chinese criminal law, the charge is "拐卖儿童" (if for trafficking) or "非法拘禁" (illegal detention) or "绑架" (kidnapping). The fact: "抱走藏匿，欲偷走自己收养" - seems like kidnapping/abduction of a minor. The appropriate charge likely "拐骗儿童" or "拐卖儿童". However the fact says "欲偷走自己收养" maybe "拐骗" (abduction). The typical charge: "拐骗儿童罪" (Article 240 of Criminal Law). So we should output that.

Thus final answer: [罪名]拐骗儿童<eoa>
